title: Polyoxometalate-ionic liquid functionalized magnetic nanocomposites for solid phase extraction and HPLC determination of sulfonamides in food samples
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,4241-4251
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08607H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zahra Nazar, Ayed M. Binzowaimil, Sidra Iram, Muhammad Tayyab Ishaq, Muhammad Sajid, Hafiz Muhammad Asif, Mohannad Al-Hmoud, Muhammad Salman Khan
Magnetic POM-IL composites are developed for sulfonamide extraction. HPLC was applied to detect sulfonamides in milk, honey, and eggs. The reusable sorbent shows consistent extraction performance.
